issue.title: Bob Mac Capture Similar tasks: a "Replace it" row action that drafts ~~old|"superseded by"
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-dl.8 (rollout phase, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2) and listed as out of scope in plan 202610/relation_cancel_labels.md.

Proposal: add a "Replace it" row action to the Bob Mac Capture "Similar tasks" band. It inserts `~~<route>:<id>|"superseded by"` for the matched existing task into the draft, so committing the new task retires the old one through bob's cancel-label commit (§17 in docs/task-relations.md). The action is an explicit draft edit only (decisions:similar-tasks-are-a-settled-heads-up), and Return behavior never changes. The relation card then shows bob's ⊘ cue as usual.

task_type_fields.proposal: Add a Replace it action to Similar tasks rows that inserts ~~<route>:<id>|"superseded by" into the draft so the capture retires the matched task through bob's §17 cancel-label commit; an explicit draft edit, Return unchanged.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Plan 202610/relation_cancel_labels.md lists it under Out of scope for bob-cli-dl; the epic shipped the cancel-label contract and cues only.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-dl's rollout phase proposed it and the epic plan put it out of scope; cancel labels now make it a one-keystroke way to retire a task a new capture supersedes.
